blockers: example.com offers no product or service; it is an IANA-reserved documentation domain
No pricing or commercial terms exist
No checkout, provisioning route, purchasing API, or programmatic payment endpoint exists
IANA states the service is best-effort, should not be used operationally, and rejects POST, PUT, DELETE, and PATCH requests
trust_events: The site is legitimate as an IANA-operated placeholder, but not a merchant; I would refuse to send credentials or payment to any purported example.com purchase flow.
notes: End-to-end purchase is impossible. The homepage says the domain is for documentation examples and to avoid operational use. IANA confirms it is unavailable for registration or transfer and not designed for production applications. Sources: https://example.com/, https://www.iana.org/help/example-domains, https://www.iana.org/domains/reserved, https://www.iana.org/news/2024/example-domain-http-methods
